title: Custom Element Upgrade & Reaction Queue
description: Trace parser upgrade, attributeChangedCallback, and connected/disconnected reactions.

steps.label: 1. Element Upgrade (constructor)
steps.description: customElements.define() upgrades existing <toast-banner> nodes and runs constructor() without touching attributes.
steps.codeHighlight: class ToastBanner extends HTMLElement { constructor() { super(); } }

steps.label: 2. Initial observedAttributes Sync
steps.description: Parser or upgrade fires attributeChangedCallback for each pre-existing attribute in observedAttributes.

steps.label: 3. Document Mount & Unmount
steps.description: connectedCallback() runs on insertion (and every DOM move!); disconnectedCallback() cleans up AbortControllers.
